title: Ingress Key Map Viewer
summary: Plot your Ingress portal keys on an interactive map by pasting your Intel inventory.
description:
Paste the Portal Keys section of your Intel inventory — tolerant of the export variants different browsers and IITC produce — and every key is plotted and grouped on a map.

- **Colour-coded by key count**, with filters for loose keys, keys in capsules, or a single capsule, and running totals for each.
- **Private by design** — everything is parsed and rendered client-side, so your inventory never leaves the browser.

Most useful for spotting stacks of duplicate keys to recycle or pass on, and for seeing your key coverage along a regular route.
